I Transmission Shift Switch Circuit
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
When shifting the shift lever in M position, using the transmission shift switch, it is possible to shift in 2 - 4
positions.
Pressing "Up switch" once shifts up 1 position, "Down switch" once shifts down 1 position respectively.
